entities.name: ON-PREM
entities.rationale: On-premises environment targeted for application discovery and server replication.

entities.name: APP DISCOVERY SERVICE
entities.rationale: AWS Application Discovery Service used to collect configuration and usage data from on-prem servers.

entities.name: SLACK
entities.rationale: Slack chat platform used for triggering or receiving migration orchestration events.

entities.name: MIGRATION TEAM
entities.rationale: Team of engineers managing and executing the cloud migration workflow.

entities.name: DYNAMODB
entities.rationale: NoSQL database used to store state and metadata for the migration pipeline.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: Central compute instance orchestrating the migration and AMI creation process.

entities.name: EC2 HOT REPLICA
entities.rationale: Target EC2 instance running as a continuously updated replica of on-prem servers.

entities.name: CLOUDENDURE
entities.rationale: CloudEndure Migration service replicating physical/virtual servers into AWS.

entities.name: BAKE AMI
entities.rationale: Amazon Machine Image built and golden-baked during the automated migration workflow.

entities.name: SHARED AMI
entities.rationale: Shared Amazon Machine Image distributed across target AWS accounts or environments.

visual_connections.description: On-premises infrastructure sends inventory and discovery data to Application Discovery Service.
Direct server replication connection from on-prem host to the target EC2 Hot Replica.
Migration Team triggers commands and receives updates via Slack.
Slack integration hooks trigger orchestration logic executed on EC2.
Orchestration EC2 queries discovery metrics from Application Discovery Service.
EC2 orchestrator manages replication tasks executed by CloudEndure.
CloudEndure provisions and maintains the updated EC2 Hot Replica instance.
Orchestrator initiates the AMI baking process to build the golden image.
Baked AMI is shared across boundary accounts into target EC2 environments.
